name: @tomgrv/vps-access
description: Confirm which services are public or internal, and the DNS names they are reached on

SYSTEM_EXTERNAL_DOMAIN.description: Wildcard DNS domain pointing at this VPS (e.g. apps.example.com for *.apps.example.com); empty = <public-ip>.nip.io fallback

SYSTEM_INTERNAL_DOMAIN.description: DNS domain pointing at this VPS's internal (Tailscale/Cloudflare) address, for services set to internal; empty = the external domain

SYSTEM_ACCESS_MENU.description: Ask to confirm visibilities and DNS (true/false); false keeps the saved or default choices

SYSTEM_INTERNAL_APPS.description: Comma list of the apps served on the internal network only (e.g. rancher,coder); overrides the menu and each app's default

SYSTEM_PUBLIC_APPS.description: Comma list of the apps served on the server IP; overrides the menu and each app's default
